title: Otto's house
summary: Otto's house is where Otto lives, near Mek'ele in Ethiopia.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
After picking up the Huntik team at the [[Mek'ele Airport]], [[Otto]] drove them to his house in a nearby village to rest for the night. The next day, locals mindcontrolled by [[The Professor]] cornered the team by surrounding the house. After fighting them off, they quickly jumped in [[Otto]]'s car and left. {{source|The Golden Asp}}

Otto's house is where Otto lives, near Mek'ele in Ethiopia.

History

After picking up the Huntik team at the Mek'ele Airport, Otto drove them to his house in a nearby village to rest for the night. The next day, locals mindcontrolled by The Professor cornered the team by surrounding the house. After fighting them off, they quickly jumped in Otto's car and left. [The Golden Asp]
